_about: Expansion Packs: named bundles the Shop can install (and remove) in one go. GUI apps are Flatpaks (sandboxed, no reboot, easy to remove); command-line things that have no Flatpak are RPMs layered with rpm-ostree. Every member goes through the app policy (app-policy.json) before anything is installed. 'includes' pulls in other packs. Nothing here is in the base image.

packs.name: Game Downloads
packs.description: Adds Games and BIOS to the Shop: download ROMs and emulator BIOS files straight into GameBox's library, and full Xbox disc dumps are converted for xemu. Switched on separately in Settings, with a one-time disclaimer, because it fetches copyrighted content.

packs.name: Developer Tools
packs.description: IDEs, editors and Git tools: VS Code, Sublime Text, Neovim, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, Eclipse, DBeaver, Android Studio, gitg, git-gui, gitk, vim. Several have a built-in terminal.

packs.name: Language Toolchains
packs.description: Rust and Cargo, Go, Java (OpenJDK) and Ruby. Node.js and npm stay in the base image (Claude Code needs them).

packs.name: Game Development
packs.description: Godot (2D/3D engine) and LOVE (Lua 2D framework). Tiled is already installed.

packs.name: Creative
packs.description: Art, photo and video: GIMP, Krita, Inkscape, darktable, Blender, Kdenlive, HandBrake, Audacity and Flameshot.

packs.name: Music Studio
packs.description: Make music: MuseScore, LMMS, Hydrogen, Qtractor and Carla.

packs.name: Wine
packs.description: Wine for running Windows programs directly (games run through Proton and Game Packs without it). Layered with rpm-ostree; needs a restart.

packs.name: Robotics
packs.description: The Fedora Robotics suite: OpenCV, the ROS build tools and the RoboCup soccer simulator. Layered with rpm-ostree; needs a restart.

packs.name: Virtualization
packs.description: Virtual machines and Android: QEMU with the Virtual Machines app (appears in the grid once installed; host device passthrough included), and Waydroid to run Android apps and games. Layered with rpm-ostree; needs a restart. Set Android up afterwards from Android Setup in the grid.

packs.name: Everything
packs.description: Every Expansion Pack above, in one click.
